description: This file contains utility functions and macros for the ConfUI component within the Cuttlefish project, including string manipulation, digit checking, and logging macros.

methods.name: Enum2Base
methods.description: Converts an enum value to its underlying integer type.

methods.name: ArgsToStringWithDelim
methods.description: Concatenates multiple arguments into a single string separated by a delimiter.

methods.name: ArgsToString
methods.description: Concatenates multiple arguments into a single string with no delimiter.

methods.name: IsOnlyDigits
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only digit characters.
